title: Monthly Community Fees on the Apartment Home Lease
content:
Three recurring monthly fees are posted with rent on the Apartment Home Lease: the amenity fee, the doorstep trash valet fee and the smart home package fee (smart lock, thermostat and leak sensors). Their monthly amounts depend on the floor plan. An amount of $0.00 means the service is included in rent.

| Floor plan | Amenity fee | Trash valet fee | Smart home package fee | Total of the three per full month |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Studio Residence | $25.00 | $30.00 | $39.00 | $94.00 |
| One-Bedroom Residence | $25.00 | $30.00 | $39.00 | $94.00 |
| One-Bedroom Den Residence | $30.00 | $30.00 | $39.00 | $99.00 |
| Two-Bedroom Residence | $35.00 | $35.00 | $45.00 | $115.00 |
| Three-Bedroom Residence | $40.00 | $35.00 | $45.00 | $120.00 |
| Penthouse Residence | $0.00 (included in rent) | $0.00 (included in rent) | $0.00 (included in rent) | $0.00 |

### Reading the table

- The total column is the sum of the three monthly amounts on a floor plan, shown for convenience; each fee is its own charge.
- On the Penthouse Residence all three services are included in rent.
- The amenity fee rises by floor plan from $25.00 to $40.00; the trash valet fee is $30.00 on the three smaller floor plans and $35.00 on the Two-Bedroom and Three-Bedroom Residences; the smart home package fee is $39.00 on the three smaller floor plans and $45.00 on the Two-Bedroom and Three-Bedroom Residences.
